sourceText:
Simple Banana Bread
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Friday, May 24, 2013 - 10:07am

Ingredients




3-4 Bananas
1 cup sugar
1 cup brown sugar
4 tablespoons butter
3 eggs
1 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. baking soda
2 cups flour
½ cup chocolate cookie crumbs – (or vanilla cookies, the choice is yours)

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 In a mix-master combine the bananas, butter and the sugars and mix on low.   Add the eggs and continue to mix on low. 3 In a separate bowl combine the flour, baking powder and the baking soda.  Slowly, add this to the banana mixture and continue to mix on low speed until a batter is formed.  This will only take a minute. 4 Butter a bread dish and add the mixture to the prepared dish.  Top the batter with the cookie crumbs. 5 Bake for about 50-55 minutes or until the toothpick test comes out clean.
